title: Lyrik findings report (1.2)
description: Lyrik security-assessment skill output. The prose spec is the Findings schema section of docs/lyrik.md. 1.2 adds to 1.1: a finding of any class is kept, where 1.1 named two. A 1.1 document is a valid 1.2 document.

stable_id.description: Conforms to <framing>::<rel_file>:<line> with framing a class name ([a-z][a-z0-9_]*) and line a decimal integer. A document with schema_version 1.1 uses only auth and injection. Parse right-to-left for the line separator. See spec for full grammar.

items.description: The finding's class. 1.1 named two, auth and injection; 1.2 keeps a finding of any class.

detection_source.description: Provenance of the candidate. Promoted from the allowed-extras band in 1.1; optional, but enforced as a closed enum when present. `both` is produced only by per-walk dedup when static_prescreen and model_reasoning converge on the same location; single-call mode never produces it.
